Valuation technique
Items of property, plant and equipment in
Kenya and Tanzania, other than motor
vehicles, are revalued every 3 to 5 years, at
values determined based on a valuation done
by Ms Accurate Valuers Limited on 29th
March 2022. Accurate Valuers Limited is an
accredited independent valuer, and an
industry specialist in valuing these types of
investment properties. The fair value of the
properties has not been determined on
transactions observable in the market because
of the nature of the property and lack of
comparable data. Instead, valuation model in
accordance with that recommended by the
International Valuation Standard Committee
has been applied.
The resulting fair value change is dealt with
through other comprehensive income.

This relates to leasehold land upon which the
manufacturing plants are set up. These assets
are revalued every 3 to 5 years, at values,
based on valuation done by Ms Accurate
Valuers Limited on 29th March 2022.
Accurate Valuers Limited is an accredited
independent valuer and an industry specialist
in valuing these types of properties. The fair
value of the leasehold land has been
determined based on comparable transaction
in the market. Additionally, valuation model
in accordance with that recommended by the
International Valuation Standard Committee
has been applied.
